SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.unit.selectUnitTestList */ testCaseId, taskId, taskName, testCaseName, testTarget, testType, priority, description, precondition, testData, testSteps, expectedResult, actualResult, testStatus, executionDate, duration, notes, requirements, assignee, createdAt, updatedAt, createdBy, updatedBy, fileCount, testStatusName, testTypeName, priorityName, isDeleted FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT UTC.ID as testCaseId, UTC.TASK_ID as taskId, UTC.TASK_NAME as taskName, UTC.TEST_CASE_NAME as testCaseName, UTC.TEST_TARGET as testTarget, UTC.TEST_TYPE as testType, UTC.PRIORITY as priority, UTC.DESCRIPTION as description, UTC.PRECONDITION as precondition, UTC.TEST_DATA as testData, UTC.TEST_STEPS as testSteps, UTC.EXPECTED_RESULT as expectedResult, UTC.ACTUAL_RESULT as actualResult, UTC.TEST_STATUS as testStatus, DATE_FORMAT(UTC.EXECUTION_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as executionDate, UTC.DURATION as duration, UTC.NOTES as notes, UTC.REQUIREMENTS as requirements, UTC.ASSIGNEE as assignee, DATE_FORMAT(UTC.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(UTC.UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as updatedAt, UTC.CREATED_BY as createdBy, UTC.UPDATED_BY as updatedBy, UTC.IS_DELETED as isDeleted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_attachments FA WHERE FA.REF_TYPE = 'UNIT_TEST' AND FA.REF_ID = UTC.ID AND FA.IS_DELETED = '0') as fileCount, CASE UTC.TEST_STATUS WHEN 'PEN' THEN '대기' WHEN 'RUN' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'SUC' THEN '성공' WHEN 'FAI' THEN '실패' ELSE UTC.TEST_STATUS END as testStatusName, CASE UTC.TEST_TYPE WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상케이스' WHEN 'BOUNDARY' THEN '경계값' WHEN 'EXCEPTION' THEN '예외처리' WHEN 'PERFORMANCE' THEN '성능' ELSE UTC.TEST_TYPE END as testTypeName, CASE UTC.PRIORITY WHEN 'HIGH' THEN '높음' WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN '보통' WHEN 'LOW' THEN '낮음' ELSE UTC.PRIORITY END as priorityName FROM UNIT_TEST_CASE UTC WHERE UTC.IS_DELETED = 'N'
ORDER BY UTC.CREATED_AT DESC ) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
